zh: 一组的中位数需要组里还有一个不小于它的数；把各组中位数从大到小排，第 j 大的中位数至少需要 2j 个不小于它的元素。
所以第 j 个中位数不超过降序第 2j 个元素；用最大的若干个数两两配成（最大值, 中位数），再各配一个最小的数，就能同时取到这些上界。
降序排序后依次取第 2、4、…、2⌊n/3⌋ 个元素（0 基下标 1、3、5…），只累加正数，负收益的组不建；输出总和，用 64 位整数。
en: A group's median needs another member at least as large; listing the medians from largest to smallest, the j-th largest median needs at least 2j elements not smaller than it.

So the j-th median is at most the 2j-th element in descending order; pairing the largest numbers two by two as (maximum, median) and adding one of the smallest numbers to each group reaches all these bounds at once.

Sort in descending order and take the 2nd, 4th, ..., 2*floor(n/3)-th elements (0-based indices 1, 3, 5, ...), adding only the positive ones, since groups with negative gain are not built; output the sum using 64-bit integers.

explanationEn:
## Approach

Sort in descending order and examine the 2nd, 4th, … 2⌊n/3⌋-th items in turn, adding only the positive ones.

## Proof of correctness

When building q groups, ordered by median from largest to smallest, the j-th median needs at least 2j elements not smaller than it, so it does not exceed the 2j-th item in descending order. Using the largest 2q items in pairs as maximums and medians, and then matching them with the smallest q items, reaches all these upper bounds at once. Since q≤⌊n/3⌋ and the candidate medians are non-increasing, adding only the positive contributions is optimal.

## Complexity

Time O(n log n), space O(n).
